Our client is a global leader in integrated solutions for the airport/aviation industry. With design and consulting teams across Europe, Africa, and Asia, the company delivers high-impact airside infrastructure projects worldwide.

 To strengthen its European Design & Consulting team, ADB Safegate is currently looking for a  Designer based in Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your main responsibilities include:

• Managing airside design and consulting projects from concept to execution
• Coordinating multidisciplinary teams (designers, technicians, external consultants)
• Producing and reviewing technical reports, engineering calculations, and design documentation
• Developing airside infrastructure designs (lighting, signage, markings, cabling, AVDGS systems, etc.)
• Preparing bill of quantities and technical specifications for tendering and project execution
• Ensuring compliance with ICAO standards and aviation regulations
• Providing technical support during installation, testing, and commissioning phases
• Communicating effectively with clients and internal stakeholders, presenting design solutions
• Identifying opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement in tools, processes, and systems
• Supporting and mentoring junior team members

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering
• Minimum 5 years of experience in design projects (aviation/airport industry strongly preferred)
• Strong knowledge of AutoCAD (mandatory)
• Good understanding of airside infrastructure and airport operations is a strong asset
• Fluent in English 
• Based in Belgium or willing to relocate

Our client is an international industrial company operating a complex manufacturing environment with a strong focus on operational excellence and energy efficiency.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze electrical energy consumption and identify optimization opportunities across the site.
• Conduct electrical studies and calculations (load flow, short-circuit, selectivity) and develop electrical schematics using EPLAN in compliance with applicable standards.
• Identify, develop, and implement energy-saving projects related to electrical distribution, lighting, motors, drives, and network infrastructure.
• Coordinate electrical network improvement projects, ensuring proper documentation, safety compliance, and stakeholder alignment.
• Manage electrical documentation, inspection plans, and emergency power systems while reporting progress and recommendations to management.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Energy Engineering, Electromechanics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in energy management or electrical engineering within an industrial environment.
• Strong analytical mindset with a genuine interest in sustainability and energy optimization.
• Solid knowledge of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, energy regulations, and industrial compliance requirements.
• Autonomous, proactive, solution-oriented, and able to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
• Fluent in Dutch and English

Our client is a leading international group active in industrial solutions. Operating in a dynamic Benelux environment, they combine global standards with local agility. They are looking for an EHS Specialist to strengthen safety culture, support operations and projects, and drive continuous improvement across multiple entities.

Jobomschrijving

• Champion a strong safety and environmental culture
• Maintain and improve EHS systems (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, VCA)
• Support projects with safety methodologies (HAZOP, RAMS, PSSR)
• Act as EHS point of contact for operational field teams
• Conduct risk assessments, audits, and site safety reviews
• Investigate incidents and define preventive measures
• Deliver EHS training and awareness programs
• Ensure compliance with BE/NL regulations and reporting

• 5+ years in EHS within an industrial or service environment
• Strong knowledge of safety regulations (Belgium required, NL is a plus)
• Experience with EHS management systems (ISO 45001 / VCA)
• Familiar with project safety tools (HAZOP, RAMS…) is a plus
• Fluent in Dutch and English; French is a strong asset
• Autonomous, pragmatic, and hands-on mindset
• Strong communicator with influencing skills

Our client is a leading international organisation operating within the real estate, construction, and professional services sector. With a strong global presence and a reputation for excellence, the company delivers innovative property solutions in a collaborative, diverse, and forward-thinking environment focused on operational excellence and sustainable growth.

Jobomschrijving

• Lead the end-to-end delivery of design and construction projects
• Establish and manage project budgets, forecasting, and funding requests
• Build and lead multidisciplinary project teams
• Manage procurement processes for consultants, contractors, and suppliers
• Coordinate internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle
• Monitor project performance, KPIs, reporting, and governance processes
• Lead change management activities and manage project modifications
• Conduct contractor evaluations, tender reviews, and award recommendations

• Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, or related discipline
• Minimum 5 years of experience in project management within construction, engineering, real estate, or a related environment
• Proven experience managing multiple projects simultaneously
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
• Demonstrated leadership and team management experience
• Fluent in English and French or Dutch

If you enjoy working on real robots in real environments and want to see your software operating in 

the field, this role offers the opportunity to make a tangible impact in a fast-growing and innovative 

sector.
 

This is what your job will look like:
 

As a robotic engineer, you will be part of our driven engineering team, where you will work together to 

develop high-quality software solutions. Your tasks will include:
 
 

• Develop, maintain, and improve robotic software using 
ROS2 

• Integrate and optimize 
navigation stacks, SLAM, and sensor fusion 

• Build perception systems using 
Computer Vision (e.g., object detection, visual localization) 

• Design and deploy 
Machine Learning models for robotic perception and autonomous decisionmaking 

• Work hands-on with real robots: system integration, deployment, tuning, and performance 

optimization 

• Contribute to robot control, localization, and path planning 

• Participate in on-site testing and customer deployments across Belgium and the Netherlands  

That's why this job suits you:
 
 

• You are hands-on and have 3-5 years of experience and strong affinity with autonomous navigation, robotics, machine control or industrial automation 

• Thorough knowledge of 
ROS2, C, C++, and Python 

• Solid knowledge in majority of the following fields: 
 

• Sensor fusion for state estimation and localization 

• Control systems for robotics 

• Path planning & Navigation (SLAM) 

• Computer Vision and Machine Learning applied to robotics   

• You’re comfortable working with hardware and in realworld field environments and experience bringing systems from prototype to reliable field deployment 

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your work 

• You have a valid EU driving license (for site testing and deployments) 

• You can communicate fluently in English

jobs.description:
**Location:**  Ghent

Client confidential

Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future? If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

This is us, your new colleagues

You will work in a dynamic environment with colleagues from all over the world, where your team is your family away from home. Our diversity makes us stronger, as we speak 21 different languages in order to support our customers.

We are a 24/7 operation and our department is spread over three European sites – Ghent (Belgium), Rugby (UK) and Bucharest (Romania), as well as our team in Johannesburg (South Africa). Everyone shares a passion for giving the customer the best experience possible and solving any problems that might arise.

This is the job

- Our multi-lingual advisors utilise their language skills to support customers with international breakdowns. It doesn’t matter where they are in Europe, we take full ownership of the breakdown and give our customers a peace of mind.
- Communication is key. We are in regular dialogue with the dealer doing the repair and updating the customer with progress.
- A creative and proactive approach to problem solving ensures our customers are well supported. When things aren’t going smoothly, we think outside the box.
- Teamwork and collaboration are the foundations of our business 

Are you the one?

- You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers.
- You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported.
- You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset.
- You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up.
- You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills.
- You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients.
- You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German.

A perfect match? Just some of the benefits working for us...

- Competitive salary, with meal vouchers, transport costs, shift allowance, etc.
- Well-being services
- Restaurant on site
- Opportunity to grow within the company
- Good work life balance
- International environment
- Support in relocation when moving from abroad

Für den Standort Brüssel suchen wir:

Solution Architect (m/w/d)

Your tasks:

- Analysis of functional and technical requirements and derivation of suitable solution architectures
- Creation of architecture concepts, technical designs, and standards
- Advising internal stakeholders on technologies, architecture principles, and best practices
- Evaluation and selection of suitable technologies, platforms, and system components
- Ensuring the technical quality, scalability, security, and maintainability of the solution
- Supporting the entire software life cycle – from planning and implementation to operation
- Coordinating and liaising with development teams, project managers, and external partners
- Conducting architecture reviews and risk analyses
- Documenting architecture decisions and relevant technical artifacts
- Assisting with the preparation of cost estimates and project plans

Your qualifications:

- Degree in computer science, business informatics, or comparable qualification
- Several years of professional experience in software development or system architecture
- In-depth knowledge of modern IT architectures (e.g., cloud, microservices, API design, integration)
- Understanding of common technologies and frameworks depending on the area of application
- Experience with architecture methods and standards (e.g., TOGAF, UML, C4 model)
- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in an understandable way
- Structured, analytical mindset and high quality awareness
- Fluent German and English skills
- Willingness to travel approx. 50% of the time

We offer:

- Career opportunities
- Individually tailored training program
- Fair, trusting working environment
- Regular networking events
- Benefits from our partners in the areas of health, insurance, and shopping
- Company pension plan

The requirements for employees are diverse. So are our job offers. Guldberg stands for “perfect matching” and specializes in the automotive, rail vehicle technology, plant engineering, telecommunications, banking, and insurance industries, offering you exciting opportunities in the fields of mechanical engineering, electronics, and information technology. For us, our employees always come first. In addition to attractive pay, we offer you long-term career prospects. Your career opportunities are complemented by a customized training program, ranging from personal development to professional qualifications. We are also committed to creating a fair, trusting, and personal working environment. In addition to regular networking events, we offer you benefits with our partners in the areas of fitness, health, insurance, and shopping.

Our client, an international company operating in the manufacturing sector, is looking for a Customer Service Representative to join its customer-facing team.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will be responsible for managing customer orders from A to Z, ensuring an excellent customer experience, and acting as the key point of contact between customers and internal departments. You will work closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Production teams to guarantee smooth order processing and timely deliveries.Key Responsibilities

• Manage customer orders throughout the entire order-to-cash process.
• Enter and follow up on orders in the ERP system.
• Serve as the primary contact for customer enquiries regarding orders, deliveries, and product availability.
• Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure efficient order fulfillment.
• Monitor delivery schedules and proactively communicate any changes or delays.
• Resolve customer issues and identify appropriate solutions.
• Maintain accurate customer records and administrative documentation.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives related to customer service processes.
• Build and maintain strong long-term customer relationships.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Previous experience in Customer Service, Order Management, Sales Support, or a similar administrative position.
• Strong communication skills and customer-oriented mindset.
• Fluent in Dutch and English. French is considered an asset.
• Experience working with ERP systems (SAP knowledge is a plus).
• Good command of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Personal Skills

• Proactive and solution-oriented.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Able to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Team player with a collaborative mindset.
• Resilient and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
• Customer-focused with excellent relationship-building skills.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology firm bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. Through this work, they make a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.

They are currently in a phase of significant growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

This position is part of our talent pool. We are not actively recruiting for this position at the moment, but we will carefully keep track of your application and contact you when the role becomes available again

Join our team as a Warehouse & Operations Associate and contribute to a mission that truly makes a difference in the fight against life-threatening diseases such as bloodcancer. 

In this role, you will be part of a supportive and collaborative environment within a leading global pharmaceutical company.

As a Warehouse & Operations Associate, your responsibilities will primarily focus on operational warehouse activities with an accurate administrative follow-up. 
	
• Responsible for inbound and outbound warehouse activities in a GMP-regulated environment.	
• Receive, handle and store cryopreserved blood samples (cells) from cancer patients, which serve as the critical starting material for the manufacturing process.	
• Manage inventory, warehouse materials and internal material requests to support other departments.	
• Use SAP to process warehouse transactions and ensure accurate inventory records.	
• Maintain documentation, traceability and compliance with GMP and quality requirements.	
• Collaborate closely with other departments to support smooth day-to-day activities.

	
• You have experience in logistics, warehousing, or operational environments, or you are eager to learn and develop yourself in this field.	
• You work accurately, pay close attention to detail, and follow procedures to ensure quality, compliance, and safety.	
• You are reliable, proactive, and take ownership of your responsibilities.	
• You enjoy working in a team and collaborate effectively with colleagues across different departments.	
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing.	
• You can commute independently to the site and are comfortable working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

As an Order Picker working in our dynamic 2-shift system, you'll be right in the heart of the action, responsible for:
 
 

• Scanning and sorting goods on pallets like a logistics whiz. 

• Getting those orders prepped and ready to roll out. 

• Ensuring every item is perfectly labeled and passes our top-notch quality checks. 

• Becoming a master of the hand scanner - your essential sidekick! 

• Tackling loading and unloading tasks with confidence. 

• Conquering heights (up to 8 meters!) on our man-up equipment - it's your mission control to efficient order picking!  

Excited to jump in and make a real impact? Got questions? Don't hesitate to ask!
 

Send an email to talent.2591@tempo-team.be or call 014 80 00 15! 
 

 
 

VG599/BUOSAP
 

 

Are You the Awesome orderpicker we're looking for?
 
 

• You thrive in a fast-paced job with lots of variety in a clean and safe setting. 

• You're not afraid of a bit of physical work - bring it on! 

• You're looking for a full-time gig with long-term prospects. 

• You're ready to dive in and start ASAP! 

• Working in a 2-shift system (early/late) fits your lifestyle. 

• You have previous experience working in a warehouse 

• You have good communication skills in Engelish of Dutch 

• Heights? No sweat! You're ready to take on the warehouse from every angle.  

- scanning and sorting goods on pallets
 

- preparing orders 
 

- labeling goods and checking for quality 
 

- working with a hand scanner
 

- loading and unloading goods
 

- working with a man-up at height (max. 8 meters)

Are you an experienced orderpicker who speaks fluent English or Dutch and wants to work in a 2 shift system in Westerlo? At DSV you will start immediately in a modern warehouse environment where a team of logistics experts shapes the future of transport and distribution every day. The atmosphere in the department is energetic and collaborative, making you start your workday with great enthusiasm. As a specialized orderpicker in this dynamic distribution center you play a key role in the logistical process, ensuring that the cosmetic products of Estee Lauder reach their destination smoothly. The variety as a warehouse worker and logistics employee ensures that no two days are the same.
 

 
 

VG599/BUOSAP
 

 

 

• You possess a stable first experience as an orderpicker in a warehouse environment. 

• You speak and understand fluent English or Dutch to follow safety instructions accurately. 

• You are willing to work in a flexible 2 shift system with an early shift and a late shift. 

• You have no fear of heights and are willing to operate an orderpicktruck at heights up to 8 meters. 

• You are physically fit and looking for a long term fulltime job with a quick start.  

 
 
 

• You ensure the accurate scanning and sorting of various goods on pallets. 

• You pick goods based on customer orders and utilize a digital hand scanner efficiently. 

• You check incoming goods for quality and provide them with the correct labels. 

• You safely operate an orderpicktruck at heights to prepare customer orders. 

• You actively assist with the loading and unloading of trucks in the warehouse. 

• You monitor general tidiness and strictly adhere to the strict safety rules on the work floor at all times.
